title: WHAT EACH LOCAL CHURCH SHOULD BE
theme: First Thessalonians portrays the local church as a place of witness, nurture, love, discipline, instruction, and care.
proposition: Each local church should fulfill its calling to witness, nurture, love, instruct, discipline, and support its members.
sermonQuestion: What should each local church be?

outline.heading: A CENTER OF GOSPEL TESTIMONY (1 THESS. 1:8).
A NURSERY FOR SPIRITUAL BABES (1 THESS. 2:7-8).
A TARGET FOR THE DEVIL (1 THESS. 2:14-15; 3:5).
A FAMILY CIRCLE WITH LOVE PREVAILING (1 THESS. 3:12).
A SPHERE OF DIVINE DISCIPLINE (1 THESS. 4:6).
A SCHOOL FOR CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT AND FOR INSTRUCTION (1 THESS. 4:9-13).
A HOSPITAL FOR THE SPIRITUALLY WEAK (1 THESS. 5:14).
